message.workstations.station_placed: Ranch station placed, working a radius of %s blocks
message.workstations.worker_recalled: Called the worker back to the station
message.workstations.worker_no_room: No room to summon a worker - clear a space beside the station
message.workstations.highlight_off: Work area highlight: only while holding a workstation
config.workstations.enable_breeding.tool: Whether the rancher feeds animals to breed them. Independent of slaughtering, so either job can run on its own.
config.workstations.require_feed_items.t:
On: feed has to be placed in the station by hand and one item is spent per animal.
Off: animals breed for free and no feed is needed.
config.workstations.breed_interval_ticks: How long the rancher waits after feeding one animal before feeding another. 20 ticks is one second.
config.workstations.max_animals_per_type: Breeding of a species pauses once this many of them are inside the area, babies included.
config.workstations.feed_babies.tooltip: Also feed babies to speed up their growth. This eats through feed quickly.
config.workstations.play_feed_sound.tool: Play the eating sound every time an animal is fed. The happy particles show up either way.
config.workstations.enable_culling.toolt: Whether the rancher slaughters surplus animals. Independent of breeding, so either job can run on its own.
config.workstations.keep_adults_per_type: Adults of a species the rancher keeps. Anything above this gets slaughtered. Babies are never slaughtered, and neither are tamed or named animals.
How long the rancher waits after finishing one animal off before starting on the next.
config.workstations.instant_kill.tooltip:
On: one blow finishes an animal off whatever the rancher is holding.
Off: it hits for its weapon's damage and keeps swinging until the animal drops. Drops are the same either way.
config.workstations.enable_shearing.tool: The rancher carries its own shears, so there is nothing to stock. Wool lands on the ground and the sweep that always follows a harvest picks it up. Named and tamed animals are left alone.
config.workstations.enable_milking.toolt: The rancher carries its own bucket, so there is nothing to stock. Off by default: a milk bucket does not stack, so every cow milked costs a whole slot and fills a station of 27 in a few rounds.
config.workstations.work_radius.tooltip: How far the work area reaches out from the station. Anything outside it is ignored.
config.workstations.work_height.tooltip: How far the work area reaches above and below the station, so a site on a slope still counts in full.
How often the worker looks around for its next job while idle.
config.workstations.worker_respawn_ticks: How long the station waits before summoning a replacement for a worker that died or went missing.
config.workstations.open_fence_gates.too: Let the worker open a fence gate that is in its way and shut it again once through, so nothing else gets out with it. Off: gates count as solid wall, same as for any other mob.
config.workstations.shove_blockers.toolt: Let the worker shoulder mobs in front of it out of the way while walking, instead of pathing the long way round or giving up. They are only nudged sideways, never through a gateway, and players are left alone.
config.workstations.invulnerable.tooltip:
On: nothing can hurt the worker, so a creeper wandering past cannot cost you the pack it was carrying.
Off: it takes damage like any other mob, and the station summons a replacement when it dies. /kill works either way.
On: the work area highlight is always visible.
Off: it only shows while holding a workstation. The hotkey toggles this at any time.
config.workstations.show_worker_state.to: Print what the worker is doing over its head: current job, distance to its target, and why it is standing still. Useful for working out where a station is stuck.
config.workstations.worker_skin.tooltip: What this station's worker looks like. Purely cosmetic, and set per station, so two stations side by side can be told apart at a glance.
config.workstations.enable_tilling.toolt: Hoe registered plots that got trampled back to bare ground. The farmer carries its own hoe; you do not have to supply one.
config.workstations.enable_sowing.toolti: Plant bare plots with the seeds this station has been given. Which seeds those are comes from the container, and how the field is divided between them from the Seeds tab.
config.workstations.enable_harvesting.to: Break crops that have finished growing. The produce lands on the ground and the sweep that always follows harvesting picks it up.
config.workstations.consume_seeds.toolti:
On: sowing takes one seed out of the station, so the field only runs as long as you keep it stocked.
Off: sowing is free, and what is in the container only says which seeds the farmer is allowed to plant.
How long the farmer waits after finishing one plot before starting the next. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.workstations.rescan_plots.tooltip: Takes the register of plots again from the farmland now inside the work area. Use this after building or extending a field, since the survey is otherwise only taken when the block is placed.
config.workstations.seed_weight.tooltip: This seed's weight, and the share of the field it works out to. Shares are worked out from the weights of the seeds actually in the container, so removing one re-divides the field between the rest. Set a weight to 0 to stop planting it.
